content.overview: Section 232 applies where a compromise involves merger or amalgamation; fast-track mergers of small companies and holding-subsidiary pairs use s. 233.
content.glance: Section 232 applies where a compromise involves merger or amalgamation; fast-track mergers of small companies and holding-subsidiary pairs use s. 233.
content.study: The Tribunal considers the scheme, valuation, creditors and the Regional Director and official liquidator reports. Dissolution without winding up can be ordered. Cross-border mergers with notified jurisdictions are s. 234. A fast-track merger still needs the statutory majorities and can be sent to the Tribunal if objections are received.

caseLaw.name: Miheer H Mafatlal v Mafatlal Industries Ltd
caseLaw.point: Sanction of an amalgamation turns on statutory compliance and fairness of the scheme, not on whether the court would have made the same commercial bargain.
